scope: ready lodging deep research: toba-kisara-bettei-toki / 季さら別邸 刻
method: Rakuten, Jalan, and Relux were parsed from directly readable public pages. Ikkyu, Yahoo Travel, Google Hotels, and Naver Search were checked with Aside Browser. Search snippets and AI summaries are excluded from direct review counts.

direct_review_sampling_status.why_not_300: Visible pool is small across OTAs, and accessible static/browser-read bodies reached 256. Google has 140 visible reviews, but Aside Browser review panel exposed only the current useful/low-score surface reliably; repeated scroll attempts did not load enough additional Google-native bodies for direct counting.
direct_review_sampling_status.narrative_status: 150-299 direct reviews with multi-platform evidence; B grade with explicit termination reason.
